text:
Accepted @wholemars challenge and tried Grok Bot.

I have zero coding experience. My earlier attempt at OpenClaw went nowhere.

In the last two nights I set up the bot, linked my email, had it build a full 12-page household budget PowerPoint, created a team of bots to help with my wife’s business, and got it sending me daily Tesla news recaps.

Insanely easy to set up and navigate. It walks you through everything step by step.

Yes… it’s addicting.
